posts.title: Monday 22nd November, 1965
posts.description: A very keen frost this morning. Didn’t wash any cars. H got a new Rover of his own on Friday. Did some more whitewashing in the boiler room. Did the usual.

posts.title: Sunday 21st November, 1965
posts.description: A keen frost this morning. Got up first and lit fire. Made a cuppa. Gave Nell a bit of a hand. The gang came just before four. Went back 7pm. Watched telly.

posts.title: Saturday 20th November, 1965
posts.description: A cold, raw day. East wind. Cleaned the moped and the plug. Dot, Ron, Jane called on way back from the grotto. Little Jane full of it. Went to the pub.
